behavior: The Navigation Menu popup names the trigger of the open item in `aria-labelledby` with the `id` of the trigger part, so a new `id` prop of the trigger changes the name of the open popup. Base UI reads the `id` of the trigger element when a part of the menu renders. A new id of the `render` element that changes no state of the menu can thus leave an `aria-labelledby` that names no element.
